title.zh: 授权并指示薄荷省财政官退还该省1902年度拖欠土地税所征罚款，退还对象为在1903年6月30日或之前缴清该税及罚款的纳税人的法案。
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE TREASURER OF THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL TO MAKE REFUND OF PENALTIES COLLECTED UPON THE DELINQUENT LAND TAX IN THAT PROVINCE FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, TO SUCH TAXPAYERS AS SHALL HAVE MADE PAYMENT OF SUCH TAX AND PENALTIES ON OR BEFORE THE THIRTIETH DAY OF JUNE, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE TREASURER OF THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL TO MAKE REFUND OF PENALTIES COLLECTED UPON THE DELINQUENT LAND TAX IN THAT PROVINCE FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, TO SUCH TAXPAYERS AS SHALL HAVE MADE PAYMENT OF SUCH TAX AND PENALTIES ON OR BEFORE THE THIRTIETH DAY OF JUNE, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.vi: Luật cho phép và chỉ đạo thủ quỹ tỉnh Bohol hoàn trả tiền phạt thu đối với thuế đất quá hạn năm 1902 cho những người nộp thuế đã thanh toán thuế và tiền phạt vào hoặc trước ngày 30 tháng 6 năm 1903.
title.th: กฎหมายให้อำนาจและสั่งการให้เหรัญญิกจังหวัด Bohol คืนค่าปรับที่เรียกเก็บจากภาษีที่ดินค้างชำระประจำปี 1902 แก่ผู้เสียภาษีที่ชำระภาษีและค่าปรับดังกล่าวภายในวันที่ 30 มิถุนายน 1903 หรือก่อนหน้านั้น
title.id: Undang-undang yang memberi wewenang dan memerintahkan bendahara Provinsi Bohol mengembalikan denda atas pajak tanah tertunggak tahun 1902 kepada wajib pajak yang telah membayar pajak dan dendanya pada atau sebelum 30 Juni 1903.
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa dan mengarahkan bendahari Wilayah Bohol memulangkan penalti cukai tanah tertunggak bagi tahun 1902 kepada pembayar cukai yang telah membayar cukai dan penalti tersebut pada atau sebelum 30 Jun 1903.

text.en:
The treasurer of the Province of Bohol is hereby authorized and directed to make refund of the
penalties collected upon the delinquent land tax in that province for the year nineteen hundred and two to
such taxpayers of said province as shall have made payment to said treasurer of the said land tax, with the
accrued penalties, on or before the thirtieth day of June, nineteen hundred and three.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 28, 1903.
